entries.headline: Ukraine Patriot interceptor shortage reported
entries.summary: War Watch said Ukrainska Pravda reported, citing CNN, that Ukraine had run out of interceptor missiles for US Patriot air-defence systems, and said two outlets later confirmed the report.

entries.headline: EAM header code QH6VL3 reported again
entries.summary: War Watch reported another Emergency Action Message header or preamble carrying the code QH6VL3.

entries.headline: EAM header code QH6VL3 reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble carrying the code QH6VL3 at 09:04 UTC, citing reagan0965.

entries.headline: Six military cargo aircraft and overseas sightings reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six military cargo aircraft airborne over the United States, with additional aircraft sightings near Ramstein Air Base and Tokyo during the preceding few hours.

entries.headline: Explosions in Aden reported
entries.summary: War Watch said an Al Jazeera Arabic correspondent reported hearing explosions in Aden, southern Yemen, and said two outlets later confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Six USAF transports and other military aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States, other military aircraft near Japan, and a nuclear command aircraft detected earlier that day.

entries.headline: Southern England drought declaration reported
entries.summary: War Watch said Sky News reported that a severe drought had been declared in parts of southern England, and said two outlets later confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Six military aircraft and eight USAF broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a quiet hour across its monitored areas, with six notable military aircraft airborne and eight coded US Air Force radio broadcasts heard that day.

entries.headline: Guided bombs reported in Kharkiv region
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a Ukrainian Air Force statement that guided aerial bombs had hit the Kharkiv region, and said three outlets later confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Zelensky refinery-strike remarks reported
entries.summary: War Watch said its ASTRA service reported that Volodymyr Zelensky told the Financial Times Ukraine would resume strikes on Russian refineries, and said two outlets later confirmed the report.

entries.headline: USAF command jet, transports and presidential aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a US Air Force nuclear command aircraft airborne over the continental United States alongside three heavy transport aircraft and a presidential aircraft, with eight coded radio broadcasts heard that day.

entries.headline: Boeing E-4B ADFEB5 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing E-4B with registration 74-0787 and hex ADFEB5, with no callsign listed, citing a sighting by gamermodeflex and a photo by Chris Lofting via Planespotters.net.
